0.1.0.en: First release, with the Electricity and Thermostat shortcuts widgets.

0.1.1.en: Both widgets now match Homey's own dashboard widgets more closely: the same text sizes, lines and corners. Thermostat shortcuts: more compact buttons, and in dark mode the same frame as Homey's device tiles. Electricity: the lowest price is shown once when the 12h and 24h lowest are the same hour.
